content: Hello, I am Vector Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?

Correct. What is your year of birth?

I can't pay both today, but I can pay one card today: the one with six hundred overdue, not the nine-hundred one.
I have noted the credit card for 600.00 on Wednesday 14 October 2026. Could you pay 900.00 for the credit card on Thursday 15 October 2026?
No, I won't be able to pay the nine-hundred card on Thursday either.
To confirm: the credit card, 600.00 on Wednesday 14 October 2026. Do you confirm this? Please say yes to confirm.
Yes, I confirm six hundred today.
Your promise is recorded: the credit card, 600.00 on Wednesday 14 October 2026. The record is available in the secure portal. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's everything for now, thank you.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
